title: How to Get Your First Customers | Startup School
summary: A Startup School talk by YC partner and former Airbnb growth head Gustaf Alstromer on how startups get their first customers. It covers doing things that don't scale, founders learning sales, the sales funnel, and charging your first customer.
why: Commenters recommend the whole talk as practical, tactical advice for early customer acquisition and outbound sales.

quote.text: The entire video is really good actually I recommend watching the entire thing.
